project.project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

requirements.title: Review and Concur with Electrical Modifications

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Given the project's simplicity, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was also hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The 36 pages may look daunting, but you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially felt the same way, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am the mechanical PE for this change, and my scope ultimately came down to the attached file\(only highlighted portion\). The electrical situation is the same. If it works for you, let’s finalize this at \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.

value_updates.review_subject: minor electrical modifications listed in the Word file
value_updates.review_extent: limited to the relevant highlighted modifications rather than a full review of all 36 pages

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The .pdf file is a copy of the as built drawings—that is, the as built drawings from before this project introduced changes. The electrical modifications completed under this project are detailed in the word file you are reviewing and approving, so the as built electrical drawings can be amended as part of this project.

value_updates.review_baseline: pre-project as-built drawings in the PDF
value_updates.change_source: electrical changes listed in the Word file
value_updates.review_purpose: review and approve the listed changes as amendments to the as-built electrical drawings

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I requested pictures of the changes from the client so that you can use them to verify that the work was completed according to the word file eat.

value_updates.supporting_review_evidence: site pictures confirming that the completed work matches the Word-file changes

Thanks
